rationale: The plan correctly identifies that n=1 vs n=1 precludes dispersion estimation and refuses to report a per-gene FDR, instead delivering descriptive TMM-CPM fold changes with an explicit BCV-sensitivity illustration clearly labeled as non-inferential; this matches the reference exactly. QC is thorough (library size, detection rate, top-fraction genes, MA/scatter plots) though it lacks PCA/sample-distance clustering since only two samples exist, which is appropriately acknowledged as a limitation rather than faked. The expression filter (CPM>=1 in at least one sample) is minimal and justified rather than arbitrary. Normalization is done properly inside edgeR (TMM) rather than pre-normalizing counts fed into a model, though there is no real GLM/contrast structure to speak of since no model is fit — the 'contrast' is just a descriptive log2FC direction stated explicitly with labels, which is appropriate given the design but scores slightly lower since no formal design formula exists. The GSEA step is reasonably well specified (universe overlap, size bounds, named collection, seed) though it proceeds despite the extremely fragile ranking, which is defensible but not clearly 'warranted' science; it is executed carefully with heavy caveats. The report is exceptionally complete: named methods/tools, versions of caveats, thresholds, counts, and design limitations are all explicitly required outputs, and replication requirements are stated.
